plugins.name: Solarized Theme
plugins.description: The Solarized Dark (Plugin) editor color scheme and a few Python live templates (bp, logger, todo). Source: crates/rustpy-plugins/examples/solarized-theme.

plugins.name: Emacs Keymap
plugins.description: Emacs-style shortcuts layered over the Default keymap; chord sequences such as Ctrl+X Ctrl+S are approximated by single chords (Alt+W, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+G, Alt+X). Source: crates/rustpy-plugins/examples/emacs-keymap.

plugins.name: Pytest Kit
plugins.description: File templates for pytest modules and conftest.py, fixture live templates, and a "pytest current file" external tool. Source: crates/rustpy-plugins/examples/pytest-kit.

plugins.name: CSV Table
plugins.description: Read-only CSV table with source editing fallback. Source: crates/rustpy-plugins/examples/csv-table.
